page.notes: Marginal numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 and 35 are line markers in the right margin, written as notes. The Greek word after "proinde" (καρδιογνώστης) is my reading of a worn line and is uncertain. "Ierem.23" is uncertain: the number is hard to read. "peruestigationem" is printed with a long s and rendered with plain s; the word itself is uncertain. The final word "cœlos" is a catchword and is therefore not repeated in the text.
